At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Nordics region where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 30 people supporting clients across the Nordics and across Europe. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

**As a Senior Consultant (SC), you will have complete ownership of complex workstreams or several smaller workstreams and be supported by junior resources. You should be deemed as a subject matter expert (SME) both internally and by clients and you will be responsible for the following:

**

• Managing complex workstreams or multiple smaller workstreams. Often supported by junior resources

• Managing more junior consultants on projects, making sure Efficio methodologies and processes are followed

• Driving complex analysis where data is hard to access and using expertise to creatively develop conclusions and recommended solutions

• Playing a role in advising clients and designing solutions that address complex needs, achieve sustainable results, and demonstrate real impact

• Effectively managing and owning the relationship with senior stakeholders

• Planning and preparing documentation for own workstream

• Taking part in the recruitment process of potential junior consultants

Our collaborative and inclusive culture is what makes us stand out. At Efficio, colleagues with diverse backgrounds, ideas, and viewpoints come together to identify innovative solutions for our clients - and so we're looking for our new team members to bring strong communication, empathy, and relationship-building skills to maintain this culture as we grow.

We encourage our teams to proactively innovate and challenge the status-quo, backed by strong analytical thinking and creative problem-solving abilities alongside comfortable proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. We're looking for team members who enjoy and have experience of digging into complex challenges at a leading management consultancy or in a relevant industry position.

Strong opportunities for career growth are an important part of our offering; as such, we love seeing ambition and a proactive approach to shaping your career to your goals and interests.

To meet client needs, we look for flexibility to travel; you can give us a heads-up on your preferences when applying.

We'd love to hear about any additional skills or experiences you bring to the table. We're particularly interested in:

• Fluency in both English and a Nordic language

• Management consulting experience within a leading consultancy, ideally within procurement and/or supply chain

• Experience (or an interest) in strategic sourcing, procurement transformation, supply chain, operations, infrastructure, or capital projects

• Proven track record of working closely with senior client stakeholders

• Deep analytical skills and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate key issues and draw sound conclusions

• Strong grasp of detail and a 'hands-on' approach

• Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

• Ability to confidently improve existing ways of working, recognize opportunities and identify innovative solutions that add real value to clients

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Process Management & Excellence, Procurement
jobs.description:
**Location: Taastrup, Denmark

**Are you an experienced leader who can bring clarity and direction in a complex and changing environment? Can you empower highly capable specialists while creating the structure and boundaries that enable them to perform at their best? And are you comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, challenging constructively and shaping how an organisation operates?If you are motivated by leading through transformation rather than simply maintaining established processes, this could be your opportunity to help shape the next chapter of Global Direct Procurement at Novo.

**The position

**As Senior Manager, Process Management & Excellence, you will lead a newly established team within Procurement Solutions, part of Global Direct Procurement.Following the recent evolution of the organisation, your initial challenge will be to bring together a highly capable group of professionals, establish a clear operating model and create alignment around the team's purpose, priorities and ways of working.

This is not a traditional operational people-management role. Your team brings significant subject matter expertise and is capable of operating with a high degree of independence. Your role will be to provide direction, create the conditions in which they can succeed and ensure their expertise is focused on the areas that create the greatest impact for the wider organisation.

Operating across an organisation of approximately 200 colleagues, you will also act as a senior delegate and sparring partner to the Director of Procurement Solutions. You will work independently with senior stakeholders, helping translate changing organisational needs into clear priorities while establishing appropriate expectations and boundaries for the team.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading, coaching and developing a team of professionals with different levels of seniority, creating clear expectations while empowering them to operate independently.

• Establishing and continuously developing the team's operating model, mandate, priorities and ways of working.

• Creating clarity around roles, responsibilities and interfaces following organisational change.

• Acting as a senior sparring partner and delegate for the Director of Procurement Solutions and representing the team with senior stakeholders.

• Influencing and challenging stakeholders across Global Direct Procurement and connected functions, ensuring priorities and expectations remain aligned.

• Driving process excellence and transformation across purchase planning and related procurement processes.

• Setting direction across areas including risk, cost and budget processes, sourcing activities, analytics, performance management, inventory and scrap.

• Translating complex or changing business requirements into clear priorities and practical action.

• Supporting fact-based senior decision-making, including recommendations on priorities, trade offs, resources, risks and business impact.

• Building an engaged and aligned team with a strong sense of collective purpose, accountability and performance.

**About The Department

**Global Direct Procurement is responsible for end-to-end procurement strategy and execution for direct materials and services supporting Novo's global manufacturing network. The organisation is strengthening global scale, standardisation, cross-regional collaboration and transparency across procurement activities.

Procurement Solutions is one of the business functions within Global Direct Procurement. It brings together specialist capabilities in business partnering, project management, process management, analytics, planning excellence and risk management.

The Process Management & Excellence team works across the wider organisation, supporting strategically important processes and priorities. As the organisation continues to evolve, the team has an important role in creating greater clarity, consistency, performance and transparency across Global Direct Procurement.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across category management, strategic sourcing, supplier operations, digital procurement, finance, supply chain and risk.

**Your Skills And Qualifications

**We are looking for an experienced, structured and independent people leader who can create followership in a complex stakeholder landscape. You combine strategic ownership with pragmatic execution and are motivated by building a team that helps the wider business perform better.

**We Expect That You Have

**

• A master's degree or equivalent within business administration, supply chain, engineering, economics or another relevant field.

• Significant experience from procurement, supply chain, sourcing, process excellence, operational excellence, business transformation or a related area within a complex international environment.

• Proven people leadership experience with professionals with different levels of seniority.

• Demonstrated experience owning a functional agenda, operating model, governance structure or transformation roadmap beyond pure execution.

• Experience driving cross-functional process improvements, analytics, planning excellence or implementation of process solutions.

• An understanding of direct procurement value chains and experience in areas such as sourcing, risk management, planning, budgeting, performance management or business case development.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, challenge and build alignment across seniority levels and functions.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Direct procurement expertise would be valuable, but it is not the only route into this position. We are equally interested in leaders from areas such as supply chain, operational excellence or business transformation who can demonstrate strong people leadership and experience shaping organisations through change.

As a person, you create clarity in ambiguity and make fact-based recommendations. You are comfortable taking ownership and challenging constructively, while empowering talented specialists to operate independently. You combine collaboration and inclusion with the judgement and resilience required to establish boundaries, make decisions and maintain focus in a changing environment.

**Why Novo

**At Novo, we don’t wait for change. We drive it. We’re a dynamic company in an even more dynamic industry, and we know that what got us to where we are today is not necessarily what will make us successful in the future. We embrace the spirit of experimentation, striving for excellence without fixating on perfection. We never shy away from opportunities to develop; we seize them. From research and development to manufacturing, marketing, and sales we’re all working to move the needle on patient care.

**Working at Novo

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you are not just starting a job – you are becoming part of a story that spans generations.

Salary and benefitsThe salary range for this position is DKK 742,600 to 1,091,600 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.

**Incentives And Benefits

**Novo offers a competitive compensation package, including pension, bonus opportunities and a range of employee benefits designed to support your professional and personal wellbeing.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the unique opportunity to work at a global healthcare company. We offer you the chance to make a difference in the lives of millions of people living with serious chronic diseases. In addition, you will have access to opportunities for professional development and career progression in an international organisation.

We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

An internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security will give you the opportunity to gain insight into the work of identifying, preventing, and addressing security threats and risks that affect the activities, employees, and reputation of private corporations.

At the same time, the internship will allow you to test your skills in an environment of researchers, analysts, and advisors with experience from, among other places, national intelligence and security services.

As an intern at CERTA, you will be an integral part of the team you are assigned to and will be given a supervisor. The specific tasks you will be responsible for will vary depending on the team you join.

CERTA offers ongoing internships in each of the following areas:

• Intelligence collection and analysis

• Security consulting

Duration and Application Deadlines

We are looking for interns twice a year, and the internship lasts for six months:

• Spring (February 1st – July 31st)

• Application period is October 15th to November 15th the previous year

• Autumn (August 1st – January 31st)

• Application period is April 15th to May 15th

Requirements

You must be a student enrolled in a higher education institution at the bachelor’s or master’s level. Your application should specify whether the internship can be credited toward your degree and if you will receive student grants (SU) during the internship.

It is not a requirement that you are a Danish citizen or that you speak and write Danish fluently, although it may be beneficial if you understand Danish to some extent.

Qualifications

We are looking for students with strong analytical skills and methodological abilities, dedication, as well as a curious, open, and positive approach to problem-solving. Please include good examples of these qualifications in your application. Additionally, we expect you to have good English skills and preferably knowledge of other languages, as well as being IT proficient, including familiarity with the MS Office suite (PowerPoint, Excel, and Word).

The internship should contribute to your education and will take place under the guidance of an academic staff member at CERTA Intelligence & Security. We recommend that you check in advance what academic requirements your educational institution has regarding an internship.

Vacation and Working Hours

The average working hours are 37 hours per week (excluding lunch break). You will accrue 2.08 vacation days for each month of your internship, totalling 12.5 days during your 6-month internship. If your study program requires you to write a major academic assignment in connection with your internship, you may also receive writing leave of up to 10 days, depending on the scope and complexity of the assignment.

Application

You can apply for an internship at CERTA Intelligence & Security by submitting a written and motivated application to internship@certaintelligence.com during the application period. When applying for an intern position, you must include your CV along with your diploma/grades. You may also choose to attach other relevant documents, such as references from employers or educational institutions.

Your motivated application should be written in English and not exceed one page, and it should include a description of why you want an internship, what you hope to gain from the internship, and what relevant experience and skills you have for the specific intern position.

It should be clearly stated in your application which area (“Intelligence collection and analysis” or “Security consulting”) you are applying for an intern position.

You may be invited to an interview regarding your application, and no later than two months before the start of the internship (December 1st or June 1st), you will receive a response about whether we can offer you an internship position.

jobs.occupation: Senior Scientist, Downstream, Late-Stage Process Development
jobs.description:
Join a fast-paced process development team where scientific expertise, collaboration and practical problem-solving help advance projects. As Senior Scientist, you will lead downstream development activities for mammalian cell culture processes, supporting their progression through late-stage development.

You will work closely with clients, laboratory technicians and colleagues across upstream, downstream and analytical disciplines. The role combines scientific leadership, study design, data interpretation and technical writing. Most hands-on laboratory work will be performed by technicians; you will work closely with them to develop protocols, design experiments and guide execution, ensuring studies are scientifically sound and generate decision-quality data.

**A role with scientific ownership and real project impact

**As a Senior Scientist, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of downstream development activities and contribute directly to the progression of projects. You will combine your scientific expertise with practical problem-solving and collaborate with both internal colleagues and clients.

The role gives you exposure to different projects, technologies and challenges rather than focusing on one narrow area. You will be involved in shaping studies, interpreting data and turning scientific findings into clear recommendations that support project decisions.

Your work will also give you the opportunity to collaborate closely with laboratory technicians and scientists, allowing you to stay connected to the practical side of process development while taking a leading role in the scientific direction.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Lead and coordinate downstream development activities for assigned projects, working with clients and cross-functional teams to align on project needs and deliver outcomes.

• Plan and evaluate downstream processes, including chromatography using ÄKTA systems and filtration operations such as depth filtration, virus filtration and ultrafiltration/diafiltration (UF/DF).

• Design studies and author practical protocols in close collaboration with laboratory technicians; provide scientific guidance during experimental execution.

• Interpret study results, apply appropriate statistical approaches—including design of experiments (DoE) where relevant—and communicate findings through clear presentations and reports.

• Contribute to process characterization, including failure mode and risk assessments such as FMEA, and author process characterization (PC) work reports.

• Support investigations and deviation handling by assessing technical causes, interpreting relevant data, and documenting conclusions and follow-up actions.

• Provide scientific and technical input to business activities and support the generation of information for regulatory submissions.

**Required Qualifications And Experience

**

• Education: Master’s or PhD in Biochemistry, Biochemical or Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, or a related discipline.

• Industrial experience: 5+ years with a Master’s degree, or 2+ years with a PhD.

• Downstream development: Demonstrated experience with mammalian cell culture processes.

• Unit operations: Chromatography and filtration; ideally ÄKTA systems and TFF systems.

• Study execution and data: Ability to plan, analyze and report complex development studies, including statistical analysis.

• Project work: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with scientific rigour and attention to detail.

• Communication: Strong interpersonal skills and ability to explain technical findings clearly to clients and colleagues.

• Language: Fluent written and spoken English.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience

**

• Process Characterization and FMEA

• Viral clearance studies or activities.

• Commercial manufacturing requirements and biologics regulatory frameworks, including relevant ICH guidelines and BLA submission requirements.

• Knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE), including experimental design, data analysis, and evaluation using SAS JMP

• Liquid-handling automation, such as Tecan systems.

**What Will Help You Succeed

**You take ownership, bring a practical can-do attitude and are comfortable working at pace. You collaborate closely with technicians and colleagues, communicate openly, and use data and sound scientific judgement to find a way forward as project needs and priorities evolve.

**What You Can Expect From Us

**We want you to have the opportunity to use your scientific expertise while continuing to develop professionally. In this role, you can expect:

• Scientific ownership: Take responsibility for development activities and influence how studies are designed and executed.

• Variety: Work across different projects, technologies and scientific challenges rather than doing the same thing every day.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with scientists, technicians, upstream and analytical colleagues as well as clients.

• Client exposure: Develop your ability to communicate scientific findings and recommendations directly with clients and contribute to project discussions.

• Professional development: Continue developing your expertise in downstream processing, process characterization, data analysis and late-stage development.

• Impact: See how your scientific work contributes to advancing biopharmaceutical processes towards later-stage development and manufacturing.

**A team where science and collaboration go hand in hand

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff who embody these international norms and standards and will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates who transform, inspire, and deliver high-impact sustained results, ensuring effective external relations, communications, partnership-building and resource mobilization in a rapidly changing development and funding landscape. jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Arctic fjord food webs under glacial retreat - DTU Aqua
jobs.description:
Greenland Institute of Natural Resources (GINR), the Greenland Climate Research Centre (GCRC) and DTU Aqua invite applications for a joint PhD position investigating how glacial retreat affect the structure, functioning, and stability of Arctic fjord food webs.

The position offers an excellent opportunity to combine Arctic field ecology, laboratory analyses, quantitative trophic ecology, and ecosystem modelling while working in Greenland and Denmark. You will become part of an interdisciplinary research environment spanning GINR, DTU Aqua, and the wider EDGE project.

The PhD project focuses on two contrasting fjord systems near Nuuk, Greenland, which differ in their degree of glacial influence. It is part of the Independent Research Fund Denmark project “Fjords on the EDGE: Resilience of Greenland Coastal Food Webs in a Warming Arctic”.

The overall aim is to understand how changes at the glacier–ocean interface propagates through the coastal ecosystem, from primary production to benthic communities, fish, and marine mammals. In particular, you will investigate the relative importance of benthic and pelagic energy pathways for key consumers using stable isotope analyses and stomach-content data. These observations will be integrated into an ecosystem model to explore how deglaciation tipping points may alter food-web structure and ecosystem functioning.

The position is jointly hosted by GINR in Nuuk and DTU Aqua in Lyngby. You will be based in Nuuk during the first two years and at DTU Aqua in Lyngby during the final year. Fieldwork, courses, project meetings, and collaborations will take place at additional locations throughout the PhD. You will be enrolled as a PhD student at DTU Aqua and work closely with researchers at both institutions and with collaborators in the EDGE project.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your primary responsibilities will be to:

• Conduct fieldwork in Nuup Kangerlua and Ameralik during 2027, collecting benthic and pelagic samples.
• Prepare and analyse samples for stable isotope analysis and use isotope mixing models to quantify the relative contribution of benthic and pelagic food sources to key consumers.
• Conduct fish stomach-content analyses to characterise diets and trophic interactions.
• Integrate new observations with existing datasets to develop and parameterise an ecosystem model based on the StratE2E framework.
• Use the model to investigate how glacial retreat and associated changes in pelagic production may affect fjord food-web structure, functioning, and stability.
• Publish results in international peer-reviewed journals and present findings at scientific conferences and to relevant local stakeholders.
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in Arctic marine ecosystems and interdisciplinary research. You should have:

• A two-year master’s degree (120 ECTS) in marine biology, marine ecology, fisheries science, ecosystem modelling, or a related field, with good academic results.
• A strong interest in fieldwork and laboratory-based research, including the ability to work effectively on ocean-going research vessels in Arctic environments.
• Demonstrated experience with quantitative data analysis and scientific programming in R, Python, or MATLAB.
• Knowledge of marine ecosystem dynamics and trophic or food-web ecology.
• Strong analytical and scientific communication skills.
• Fluency in written and spoken English.
The following qualifications are considered an advantage:

• Experience with ecological or ecosystem modelling, including StratE2E or similar frameworks.
• Experience with stable isotope ecology and/or mixing models.
• Experience identifying benthic organisms.
• Experience with fish diet or stomach-content analyses.
• Experience with Arctic marine ecosystems.
• A published or submitted peer-reviewed scientific publication.
• Fluency in Danish and Greenlandic.
We recognise that candidates may bring different combinations of these skills and do not expect applicants to have prior experience in all components of the project. Particular emphasis will be placed on scientific potential.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Professor Teunis Jansen (DTU Aqua and GINR) and Researcher Sandra Maier (GINR).

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures

The position is a full-time, three-year PhD appointment administered by DTU. The expected starting date is 1 February 2027. You will be based at GINR in Nuuk during the first two years and at DTU Aqua in Lyngby during the final year. GINR will assist the successful candidate with finding accommodation in Nuuk.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
For further information, please contact Professor Teunis Jansen, DTU Aqua and GINR (tej@aqua.dtu.dk), or Researcher Sandra Maier, GINR (sama@natur.gl)

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 30 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). 

Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

About DTU Aqua
DTU Aqua – National Institute of Aquatic Resources – works for well-functioning oceans, rivers, and lakes where biodiversity can thrive. Our research, advisory service, and education contribute to the development of a sustainable blue bioeconomy, robust aquatic ecosystems, and reduced effects of climate change. We have a large national and international network and cooperate with research partners, public authorities, industry, and NGOs. We have state-of-the-art research facilities and Denmark’s only ocean- and arctic-going research vessel. The Institute has about 400 employees, one-half being scientific staff, including about 45 PhD students. About 40 nationalities are represented at the institute, and we support an equal gender distribution. We are located in Lyngby, Hirtshals, Nykøbing Mors, and Silkeborg and have regular activities in Greenland. Learn more on aqua.dtu.dk

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
